subject: Request: RidgeWell customer spotlight + logo use
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@ridgewell.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer spotlight request — short quote + logo

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the pilot support — the folks here at RidgeWell have been impressed with the latency and cost numbers. Our comms team asked whether Redwood would be open to a short customer spotlight: a 2–3 sentence quote from our Head of Data + permission to use our logo on a one-page case study and a short social post.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood needs any particular legal language in the quote or release
- Any logo usage guidelines or restricted marks
- Typical turnaround for internal review and approval

I've attached our suggested quote and a ZIP with logo files. Happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Elena Morales
Director, Strategic Partnerships
RidgeWell Health

Attachments: RidgeWell_Quote_Draft.docx, RidgeWell_Logo_Pack.zip

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@ridgewell.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer spotlight request — short quote + logo

Elena — really appreciate you reaching out and glad the pilot hit the mark. Looping in Grace from Marketing and Ava from Legal so we can get the proper sign-offs. Quick answers upfront:

- We typically ask for a short permission release (one page) that authorizes use of a customer quote and logo in marketing collateral and social. We can provide a template.
- Logo usage: we prefer the master logo from your package, clear space guidelines apply; we won't alter the mark. If you have any co-branding requirements we should include them.
- Turnaround: marketing + legal review typically 3–5 business days once we have the final quote and preferred logo files.

Grace / Ava — Elena attached a suggested quote and a logo pack. Can you review the draft release and advise what edits (if any) are needed? Elena — if you can confirm the quote and whether your legal team needs a redline, we can move this to an executed DocuSign by week end.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0132

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@ridgewell.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer spotlight request — short quote + logo

Hi Elena — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the assets, they look fine at a glance. A few quick notes from Marketing:

- We prefer the 2-line quote attributed to "RidgeWell Health, Head of Data" rather than a personal name in the social post; for the case study PDF we can include the full name and title.
- Please confirm the preferred hero logo (PNG vs SVG) and whether we should use horizontal or stacked lockup.
- We typically include a one-sentence about data handling (e.g., "Redwood Inference processed pseudonymized telemetry on RidgeWell's dev dataset") — if RidgeWell prefers other phrasing let us know.

I'm attaching a draft one-paragraph release (Marketing + Legal combined) to this thread — it includes standard usage, a 12-month window for the social amplification plan, and an opt-out for any quote edits. Ava, any legal flags?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: RidgeWell_Marketing_Release_Draft.docx

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@ridgewell.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 14:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer spotlight request — short quote + logo

Thanks all. I reviewed the draft release and have three small edits:

1) Add explicit line that Redwood will not modify RidgeWell's trademarked logo without written consent (we keep it, but clear it's unmodified).
2) Clarify that the quote will be used "as provided" unless RidgeWell requests edits; add a simple approval step before publish (48-hour review).
3) Limit the release duration to 18 months with an ability to renew — RidgeWell asked for 12 in email; 18 gives marketing flexibility but is optional.

Elena — if you approve these changes I'll prepare a DocuSign-ready release and send it to you and Tom for signature. Diego — I'll copy the standard clause about data references (non-sensitive, high-level only).

Ava Chen
Corporate Counsel, Redwood Inference
